# Toolhub

> 328 free browser-only calculators, converters and generators. Every tool runs entirely client-side — no sign-up, no data leaves the browser. Each tool page states its formula, assumptions and edge-case handling, with a 500+ word explainer and FAQ.

## Categories

- [Financial Calculators](https://tool-hub.me/financial-calculators/): loans, mortgage, paycheck, retirement, taxes, investing
- [Health Calculators](https://tool-hub.me/health-calculators/): BMI, TDEE, calories, body fat, protein, pregnancy
- [Unit Converters](https://tool-hub.me/unit-converters/): length, weight, temperature, volume, pressure, torque
- [Date Calculators](https://tool-hub.me/date-calculators/): age, days between, week numbers, time zones
- [Developer Tools](https://tool-hub.me/developer-tools/): JSON, Base64, regex, cron, hash, subnet, UUID
- [Math Calculators](https://tool-hub.me/math-calculators/): fractions, statistics, matrices, sig figs, chemistry
- [Text Tools](https://tool-hub.me/text-tools/): word count, case convert, compare, readability
- [Everyday & DIY](https://tool-hub.me/everyday-calculators/): paint, concrete, tile, mulch, fuel, recipes
- [Random Generators](https://tool-hub.me/random-generators/): numbers, passwords, dice, teams, Secret Santa
- [Business Tools](https://tool-hub.me/business-tools/): timesheets, landed cost, inventory, commissions

## Key pages

- [All tools](https://tool-hub.me/): searchable directory of every tool
- [About](https://tool-hub.me/about.html): what Toolhub is and how tools are built
- [Sitemap](https://tool-hub.me/sitemap.xml): every indexed URL

## Notes

- Formulas cite their sources (e.g. Mifflin-St Jeor, NWS wind chill, IRS/HMRC rates with tax-year labels).
- Content language: UI in 14 languages; explainers in English.
